command: take the red cube to dispatch
summary: Successfully picked up the red cube from the table and delivered it to the dispatch_zone.

Great! The red cube has been picked up successfully. Now I need to navigate to the dispatch_zone to place it there.
Excellent! The robot has arrived at the dispatch_zone. Now I'll place the red cube here.
Perfect! The red cube has been successfully placed at the dispatch_zone. The task is complete.
